method: Fresh Chromium per viewport, D3D11, no throttling. Action timestamps are DOM click event timestamps; visible chooser uses next animation-frame paint opportunity with all four PNGs decoded. Input end is first changed-position render submission, not photon latency. Keyboard samples retain native keyboard event time. Phone additionally uses native CDP touchStart on the one-thumb pad, with its pointer event time captured independently of the runtime handler timestamp. Round2 removes Round1’s explicit1000ms ready wait and400ms view-switch wait. These stricter first-use samples do not replace previous evidence. No runtime movement tuning was made for these measurements.
